parts.name: Body
parts.Basic_description: The body of the stapler is the main upper part made of durable plastic, typically shaped for ergonomic pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the pressing lever that drives the staple through the paper and into the base anvil.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around a hinge at the rear, moving downward when pressed and returning upward when released.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is the top cover of the stapler, made of plastic, which can be lifted to load staples.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the internal staple magazine and allows access for reloading staples.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted upward around a hinge to open the stapler for staple refilling.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the bottom part of the stapler, typically made of steel for stability and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a stable platform for stapling and contains the anvil that bends the staple legs inward.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as the foundation for the stapler mechanism.
